The Data Acquisition team within the Foundations organization at OpenAI is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Data Processing, Architecture, and Scaling, to ensure seamless data ingestion and workflow management.

• Design and implement APIs to facilitate data interactions between internal services and external data sources.

• Enhance user experience by developing intuitive web-based interfaces for managing and monitoring data pipelines.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Opportunity

The Global Demand Center is building a signal-led demand engine — one that uses account, audience, behavioral, intent, and market signals to identify where we should focus and how we should activate. The GrowthX team, within the Global Demand Center, is taking the lead on this initiative and looking for a new Demand Signals Specialist.

The Demand Signals Specialist will help turn signal-led strategy into accurate, actionable audiences that can be used across campaigns, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, and activation channels.

This role is focused on audience build, enrichment, segmentation, QA, and activation readiness. They will work across teams to understand unique intent and fit signals to create impactful audiences for GrowthX programs. The ideal candidate is early in their career but technically curious, detail-oriented, comfortable working across modern GTM platforms, and excited to help build the audience foundation for a more dynamic demand model.

What You’ll Do

Build account and contact audiences

Build account, contact, and buying-group audiences based on direction from GrowthX strategy leads, campaign teams, field marketing, and journey teams.

Use tools such as Clay and Common Room to support audience creation, enrichment, segmentation, contact discovery, buying-group identification, and account research.

Apply required filters, exclusions, segmentation logic, region/segment views, product focus, persona criteria, suppression rules, and activation requirements.

Support both planned campaign audiences and signal-triggered growth motions.

Prepare audiences for activation

Package audience outputs for use by campaign managers, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, digital activation, and xDR teams.

Communicate audience size, coverage, regional breakdowns, segment views, exclusions, data gaps, intent, and activation readiness.

Help ensure audiences are structured in a way that can be used downstream in systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, and other campaign or activation platforms.

Own audience QA and data quality checks

Review audience builds for accuracy, duplication, completeness, field quality, enrichment quality, persona/title fit, suppression logic, region/segment accuracy, and alignment to stated criteria.

Flag issues, gaps, or unexpected findings to GrowthX strategy leads and stakeholders.

Recommend adjustments when audience size, coverage, quality, or data availability may limit activation.

Document audience logic and QA findings so teams understand what was included, excluded, and why.

Partner cross-functionally

Work closely with GrowthX leaders, campaign managers, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, and activation teams to support audience needs.

Clarify build requirements, timelines, audience logic, data sources, and handoff expectations.

Support a more consistent audience operating model across Okta or Auth0 platform priorities.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

1–3+ years of experience in marketing operations, growth operations, campaign operations, audience operations, demand generation, sales operations, data operations, or a related field.

Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data, lists, filters, segmentation logic, and QA processes.

Experience or strong familiarity with B2B marketing and sales systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Clay, Common Room, or comparable GTM platforms.

Comfort working with account and contact data, including enrichment, deduplication, segmentation, exclusions, and audience handoffs.

Ability to communicate audience size, coverage, data gaps, and QA findings clearly to stakeholders.

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple audience requests, timelines, and handoffs.

Curiosity about AI, signal-led demand generation, data enrichment, and modern GTM technology.

Ability to work cross-functionally with campaign, field, journey, marketing automation, and growth teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or supporting B2B account/contact audiences.

Experience with Clay, Common Room, Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, or similar platforms.

Basic understanding of B2B buyer personas, buying groups, account segmentation, lifecycle stages, and campaign activation needs.

Experience using formulas, logic, filters, or workflow tools to organize and manipulate data.

Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, identity, developer platforms, or enterprise technology.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

The Pricing Strategy team owns the end-to-end pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategy across GitLab's product portfolio, from Premium and Ultimate tiers to GitLab Duo and our expanding artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. As a Staff-level pricing and commercialization expert, you'll design, scale, and drive GitLab's enterprise monetization and commercial buying programs as an individual contributor at the top of our individual contributor track. You'll serve as the architect of our Enterprise Agreements, cloud marketplace and channel pricing structures, and competitive commercial programs, partnering across Product, go-to-market (GTM), Finance, Sales, Renewals, Product Marketing, Partners, and Deal Desk to turn pricing decisions into scalable programs that work for customers and the field.

What you'll do

• Drive competitive pricing programs and tactical deal plays, including promotions, competitive replacement offers, and deal support, that help the field win and displace competitors in the DevSecOps and AI tooling market.

• Own list-to-net price realization strategy across products, geographic regions, GTM segments, and routes to market.

• Partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, and GTM leaders to shape new packaging and pricing proposals, evaluate monetization models as GitLab's AI and platform capabilities evolve, and bring data-backed recommendations to cross-functional and executive stakeholders.

• Act as the go-to expert for pricing enablement by building training, playbooks, and battlecards that give the field confidence in pricing conversations and help them explain commercial value.

• Put commercial programs into practice in partnership with Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, and Data teams, staying hands-on with execution as well as strategy.

• Define, launch, and scale Enterprise Agreements and marketed bundling strategies that simplify transactions, encourage multi-product and GitLab Duo adoption, and maximize customer lifetime value.

• Define channel and marketplace pricing strategy, including tiering, discounting frameworks, and margin structures, across resellers, global systems integrators, independent software vendors, and cloud marketplaces such as Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft Azure.

• Document decisions and frameworks in the GitLab handbook and default to asynchronous, written communication as part of GitLab's all-remote, globally distributed team.

What you'll bring

• Extensive experience across strategy consulting, pricing, strategic finance, or corporate or deal strategy, ideally at a software as a service or enterprise software company.

• Deep experience in monetization or pricing strategy, including direct ownership of pricing waterfalls, enterprise buying programs such as Enterprise License Agreements or Enterprise Agreements, or channel and marketplace pricing models.

• A track record of operating as a go-to expert without formal authority. Other teams bring you difficult pricing questions, and your recommendations carry weight with senior stakeholders because of the thinking and evidence behind them.

• Hands-on work with AI agents and automations that real teams used in production

• A bias toward iteration and shipping. You're comfortable making a strategic call, documenting the reasoning, and adjusting as new data comes in instead of waiting for perfect information.

• Strong written communication skills and the ability to work independently in an asynchronous, all-remote environment while driving cross-functional agreement.

• Experience partnering with and influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Finance, including vice president and senior vice president levels, as an individual contributor.

About the team

The Pricing Strategy team shapes how GitLab packages, prices, and commercializes its product portfolio. The team works across Product, GTM, Finance, Partners, Deal Desk, Renewals, and Data to create pricing frameworks and buying programs that can scale. In this role, you'll help connect product and monetization strategy with the practical programs used by customers, partners, and the field.

Role Description

Dropbox’s Virtual First team researches, tests, and scales better ways of working for a distributed organization. We combine organizational research, experimentation, behavioral science, technology, and employee experience to continuously improve how Dropboxers work—wherever they are.

As a Senior Program Manager, Employee Experience , you will own a strategic Virtual First work stream focused on tool optimization and technology-enabled ways of working, identifying opportunities to improve employee effectiveness and translating those opportunities into research, experiments, recommendations, and scalable organizational change.

This role combines program management with research, innovation, and cross-functional stakeholder management. You will manage a portfolio of interconnected programs rather than a single project, with particular focus on knowledge management, AI enablement, and building employee confidence with tools and technology. You will establish research priorities, design and facilitate experiments, synthesize findings, and work with partners across Dropbox to turn evidence into better ways of working.

Success in this role means creating new knowledge, translating that knowledge into clear recommendations, and driving measurable improvements in employee effectiveness, tool confidence, and adoption of AI-enabled and technology-supported ways of working.

Responsibilities

• Own the strategy, roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of a Virtual First work stream focused on technology, including tools, workflows, automations, AI enablement, and knowledge management

• Design and lead organizational research, pilots, and experiments that test new ways of working

• Translate qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable recommendations, behavioral frameworks, and operating models for downstream adoption

• Manage a portfolio of concurrent programs and initiatives from initial scoping through research, validation, and enablement planning

• Establish clear objectives, success measures, milestones, risks, and reporting across the work stream

• Facilitate cross-functional Steering Committees and initiatives involving stakeholders across People, Technology, Communications, Operations, and other business functions

• Partner with People Analytics and other measurement experts to establish research methodologies and evaluate outcomes.

Requirements

• 8 + years of experience in program management, organizational effectiveness, workplace strategy, employee experience, innovation, research, or a related discipline.

• Expertise in tools and technology enablement, including AI adoption, knowledge management, digital workflows, automation, and the design of technology-enabled ways of working that improve employee effectiveness.

• Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs from ambiguity through measurable outcomes.

• Experience designing and managing research, pilots, experiments, or other evidence-based innovation programs.

• Strong understanding of Virtual First, distributed, hybrid, or modern ways of working.

• Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills.

• Comfort working in ambiguity and proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in a distributed or Virtual First organization.

• Experience with organizational behavior, change management, behavioral science, workplace research, or human-centered design.

• Demonstrated curiosity about the future of work and emerging technologies.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

• Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others .

• Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations .

• Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change .

• Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust .

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

About the Team
The Adoption, Innovation, and Transformation team within OpenAI for Government helps government organizations turn OpenAI products into durable capabilities and measurable mission impact. This role requires the rare blend of: Evangelist, Educator, Executor, Ambassador, and Orchestrator.

We work alongside government leaders and public servants to move from exploration to confident, responsible, organization-wide use of AI, specifically our Cyber and Daybreak capabilities. Our work combines strategic communications, hands-on enablement, adoption strategy, deployment support, community, content, and practical transformation tailored to government missions and operating environments.

By translating the potential of OpenAI’s technology into better individual workflows, stronger teams, and improved public services, we help government customers deepen adoption, build lasting organizational capability, and spend more time on mission.

About the Role
We are seeking a Cyber Enablement Lead to join the AIT team and help government cyber professionals turn Daybreak’s capabilities into stronger defenses and measurable mission outcomes. This is a priority hire, and we are looking for someone who can join as soon as possible.

You will own Daybreak’s product enablement strategy and personally design, execute, and lead the training that brings it to life. Your work will span audience research, curriculum design, script writing, recorded demonstrations and courses, hands-on workshops, executive briefings, and our cyber councils. You will work with both domestic and international customers.

You will work with Authorizing Officials (AOs), CISOs, cyber operators, developers, and senior executives, adapting the depth and format to each audience. Practitioners need practical proficiency; executives need a strategic understanding of our cyber products, their value, and their implications for mission and risk. Success means demonstrated capability, sustained adoption, and better cyber outcomes.

This role is based in Washington, D.C. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Travel and regular work from government customer sites are required.

In this role, you will:
• Set the vision and own the execution of Daybreak’s government enablement strategy, from audience research and learning objectives to curricula, delivery, and measurable mission impact.

• Serve as a trusted cyber ambassador for OpenAI, leading substantive conversations and exploration of our tools and capabilities with U.S. and international government leaders, customers, and the broader cyber community.

• Shape the narratives that help governments act on AI’s changing cyber landscape, grounding executive briefings, public speaking, and thought leadership in real operational experience.

• Personally lead technical training, live demonstrations, hands-on workshops, and executive conversations that move AOs, CISOs, cyber operators, developers, and senior leaders from interest to action.

• Bring frontline experience into product development. Serve as a key point of contact for Daybreak Blue and Red, translating user feedback, deployment friction, and unmet mission needs into actionable product recommendations.

• Create learning that people can put to work: write scripts, record compelling demos and training, and build interactive labs, digital courses, videos, facilitator guides, and practical playbooks.

• Convene and lead our cyber councils, bringing leaders and practitioners into candid conversations that surface hard questions, share field lessons, and build a community of practice.

• Design for both depth and scale, delivering bespoke engagements for small specialist teams and repeatable learning programs that equip thousands of practitioners to use Daybreak effectively.

• Turn frontier capabilities into practical government workflows across the cybersecurity lifecycle, connecting Daybreak’s applications and deployment requirements to challenges such as critical infrastructure security and defense of critical networks.

• Help define effective human-machine teaming in cyber, developing practical guidance on where AI adds value, where human judgment is essential, and how teams validate results and act responsibly.

• Orchestrate work across product, security, deployment, and customer teams to address adoption barriers and keep enablement technically accurate, operationally relevant, and current as capabilities and requirements evolve.

• Prove the impact: assess demonstrated proficiency, track sustained adoption, and use evidence of stronger cyber performance and mission outcomes to improve every program.

You might thrive in this role if you:
• Hold an active security clearance, preferably TS/SCI, and be within the applicable clearance window.

• Bring deep cybersecurity expertise across threat modeling, vulnerability discovery and validation, prioritization, remediation, detection, incident response, and recovery, with the judgment to connect these disciplines to real missions.

• Have deep fluency in Daybreak’s capabilities, applications, and deployment requirements, and can translate that knowledge into credible advice and practical government cyber training.

• Have personally built and delivered cybersecurity enablement that changed how people work, from focused engagements with specialist teams to programs reaching thousands of practitioners.

• Are a compelling speaker, writer, educator, and hands-on creator. You can set the strategy, write the script, record the demo, build the lab, and lead the workshop, roundtable, or private executive session.

• Can earn trust in the executive briefing and the technical deep dive, adapting your language, examples, and level of detail while giving audiences a clear reason and a practical way to act.

• Know how to read a leader and a room. You combine presence and emotional intelligence with humility, listen carefully, welcome hard questions, and make people comfortable learning something new.

• Understand government cyber missions, security requirements, and operational constraints, ideally across DOW, federal civilian agencies, and state and local government, and can build approaches that work within those realities.

• Turn bold ambition into disciplined execution, leading cross-functional work, incorporating feedback, and taking ownership of demonstrated proficiency, sustained product use, and stronger defenses.

• Have built and led teams of cyber enablement professionals, setting a high bar for technical credibility, teaching quality, and execution while helping others grow.

• Bring a practical understanding of U.S. cybersecurity laws, regulations, and policies, and can explain what they mean for government adoption and deployment.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord seeks a seasoned Data Engineer, focusing on our advertising product data. In this role, you will drive technical vision and strategy for ads data engineering in support of our ML initiatives while building and maintaining sophisticated data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools. You will lead cross-functional initiatives to transform our advertising products through data-driven insights and mentor fellow engineers to deliver exceptional results.

This role works heavily with Data Science, Machine Learning, and product. If leading technical innovation, architecting scalable solutions, and empowering teams through data excites you, we encourage you to make a move!

What You'll Be Doing

• Design and own core ads data models : fact/dim tables, canonical datasets, and aggregation layers that power delivery, measurement, targeting, attribution, and ML use cases.

• Build and maintain the ML data that enables ads ranking, delivery, and targeting - including feature development, label generation workflows, intra-day training, and ML input observability to catch data quality issues before they degrade model performance.

• Build conversion measurement pipelines and integrate third-party attribution data - including Conversion Attribution and Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrations (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Singular) - ensuring attribution accuracy and data parity across measurement surfaces.

• Build batch and near real-time pipeline infrastructure across the ads ecosystem - pushing toward lower-latency data for ML and reporting use cases on our BigQuery + dbt + Dagster stack. Partnering with Data Platform on launch and success of new data processing engines to support low latency requirements..

• Develop data quality frameworks, monitoring systems, automated anomaly detection, and SLA infrastructure for critical ads pipelines at massive scale.

• Proactively identify foundational data infrastructure gaps - including those with broad implications across ML, measurement, and reporting - and design scalable, canonical solutions that multiple teams can depend on.

• Build systems from scratch in a rapidly evolving, greenfield advertising data environment - making sound architectural decisions with incomplete information and balancing short-term delivery with long-term infrastructure investment.

• Drive alignment across Data Science, ML Engineering, Ads Product, and GTM teams through clear narratives that connect data infrastructure decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact.

• Mentor engineers through technical challenges, code and design reviews, and ownership of complex projects - contributing to the culture and engineering standards of the Data Engineering team team.

What you should have

• 5+ years of hands-on experience writing production code and architecting data pipelines with high-volume consumer data in advertising technology domains (ad delivery, ranking, targeting, identity, conversion measurement).

• Deep expertise in digital advertising data engineering - specifically in ads delivery, conversion measurement, attribution pipelines, or ML feature data infrastructure. Experience with Conversion Data and APIs, MMP integrations, or identity graph infrastructure is strongly valued.

• Demonstrated experience building data models in a greenfield or 0-to-1 environment where requirements change frequently, documentation is sparse, and architectural decisions are made with incomplete information.

• Expert-level SQL and Python . Strong ability to design performant, maintainable data models and write production-quality pipeline code.

• Proven hands-on experience with data quality audits, monitoring systems, and automated anomaly detection for massive-scale datasets (billions+ rows) - including quality frameworks designed for ML inputs.

• Strong technical communication skills with the ability to drive alignment, influence prioritization, and earn adoption from technical stakeholders.

• Collaborative mindset and strong cross-functional instincts with experience building trusted working relationships with Data Science, ML Engineering, and Product teams.

Bonus Points

• Passion for Discord or gaming communities

• Experience with data visualization and dashboarding technologies (Looker, Tableau, or similar)

• Experience with designing data architecture to power a variety of use cases, including reporting (internal and external), adhoc analysis, experimentation.

• Working with Data AI tools to establish greater self service utility for your customers.

• Experience building near real-time or streaming pipeline infrastructure (e.g., Kafka, Spark Streaming, or equivalent) in addition to batch processing is preferred.

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Revenue Strategy and Operations Team

Revenue Strategy & Operations sits at the heart of our organization, driving operational excellence across our entire revenue organization. As part of Okta's Business Operations team, we amplify the impact across our rapidly growing Sales, Presales, Customer Success, Technical Account Management (TAM), and Renewals organizations by ensuring each function has the insights, tools, and processes to run effectively and efficiently. The team establishes rigorous standards and processes, and scales customer-centric operations to support our growth targets across the entire customer lifecycle.

The Senior Manager, xDR Sales Strategy & Operations Opportunity

As the Senior Manager, xDR Sales Strategy & Operations, you will be both the strategic engine behind the AMER xDR organization and the people leader for the EMEA and APJ xDR Operations team members. You will lead regional and global planning, own business performance reporting, and act as a trusted advisor to xDR Leaders across all three regions. In addition to directly managing the EMEA and APJ ops team, you will set the standard for how the global xDR ops function operates — building a cohesive, high-performing team that drives consistency in KPIs, processes, and systems worldwide. This is a high-impact, highly visible role for a builder who thrives in complexity, develops talent, and delivers quality at scale.

What You'll Be Doing

• Lead and Develop Global Operations Team: Manage EMEA and APJ xDR Operations professionals with clear coaching and mentorship. Set and maintain consistent operating standards across all three regions—ensuring alignment on KPIs, processes, systems, and best practices.

• Drive AMER xDR Strategy & Operations: Act as the primary strategic operations partner to AMER xDR Leadership, providing analytical guidance and operational support. Drive regional enhancements across all segments while establishing and maintaining the operational rhythm through weekly pipeline reviews, monthly cadences, and QBR preparation.

• Own Lead Management & Pipeline Quality: Lead the regional lead management process including SLA monitoring, lead routing governance, and feedback loops to Marketing. Conduct regular pipeline quality reviews to ensure stage progression hygiene, accurate close dates, and identify early signals of pipeline risk.

• Build Scalable Analytics & Reporting: Design and execute comprehensive business reviews (QBR/MBR) for AMER xDR, delivering performance insights and clear recommendations. Build scalable, repeatable reporting frameworks that enable self-serve analytics for xDR Managers and Leaders.

• Forecast Pipeline & Performance: Own regional pipeline creation forecasting, providing weekly and monthly projections to support revenue forecasting. Develop forecasting models that account for rep ramp curves, seasonality, and segment-specific pipeline dynamics.

• Execute GTM Initiatives & Planning: Lead the design and execution of broader GTM initiatives and pilot programs in partnership with Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, and Sales Enablement. Own operational execution of annual planning cycles, translating macro models into rep-level territories and quota assignments.

• Enable Data-Driven Decision Making: Deliver deeply analytical insights on xDR performance, fostering a data-driven culture. Influence senior stakeholders (VPs, Directors) through data storytelling and executive-ready communication.

• Champion Tools & Systems Excellence: Leverage deep Salesforce expertise to optimize Lead, Contact, Opportunity, and Account management. Drive adoption of Sales Development technology and explore AI/automation tools to improve reporting, forecast accuracy, and workflow scaling.

What You'll Bring to the Role

• Leadership Experience: 7+ years in an analytical, strategy, or operations role at a high-growth SaaS company, with at least 2+ years of direct people management. Proven track record of building, coaching, and developing high-performing operations or strategy teams.

• Strategic Business Partnership: Demonstrated ability to act as a true strategic partner to senior leadership—proactively identifying gaps, shaping the agenda, and mobilizing cross-functional resources to drive outcomes.

• Deep Technical Expertise: Advanced Salesforce proficiency including reports, dashboards, and complex object relationships. Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills with complex formulas and large dataset management. Experience with Sales Development tools (Outreach.io), Anaplan, Tableau, or Clari.

• Lead & Pipeline Mastery: Deep understanding of lead management KPIs and best practices for both inbound (BDR) and outbound (SDR) pipeline generation. Proficiency in capacity modeling, headcount planning, coverage forecasting, and quota-setting.

• Operating Rhythm & Planning Execution: Demonstrated experience designing and running structured rhythms of the business including weekly pipeline reviews, monthly cadences, and QBR preparation. Track record of executing annual planning cycles operationally.

• Data Storytelling & Analytics: Exceptional ability to translate complex data into clear narratives for senior audiences. Experience designing and maintaining scalable analytics frameworks that drive decision-making.

• Builder Mindset & Continuous Improvement: Comfortable rolling up your sleeves and owning deliverables end-to-end. A builder's mentality with genuine curiosity about AI tools and their operational applications—experience automating reporting, improving forecasts, or scaling workflows is a plus.

• Collaborative Influencer: Outstanding communication skills (written and verbal) with proven ability to partner with cross-functional teams, influence without authority, and drive alignment across global organizations.

• Willingness to Travel: Ability to travel to other Okta offices as required for in-person meetings and collaboration (~ once per quarter).

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence.

Role Description:

This is a Generalist Senior Backend Engineer position within the Ads Organization. Ads is the fuel that powers Reddit’s mission. As a backend engineer on the team, candidates might work on:

• Microservices and APIs that power our advertiser-facing product, ads.reddit.com

• Distributed systems that ensure the right ad gets shown to the right user at the right time

• Backends that power interactive user experiences on our ads like Polls and Games

• Real time, data intensive systems that measure the performance of our ad campaigns

• Infrastructure that supports all of the above

Technologies used on the team include:

• Languages: Go, Python, Scala

• Frameworks: Spark, Thrift, Baseplate, Kafka

• Datastores: Postgres, BigQuery, Redis, Druid

• Tools: Kubernetes, Argo, Docker

Responsibilities:

• Work with product managers to design and implement Ads products.

• Collaborate closely with the platform and data teams while building new features.

• Lead the processes needed to improve operational stability, including improving code quality, delivering dashboards and data visualizations.

• Build extensible components that would align with the product objectives.

• Support day to day project management tasks including communicating project updates, managing project timelines and overseeing project execution.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of software development experience in one or more general purpose programming languages (Java, Scala, Go, C++, Python).

• Able to take complete ownership of a feature or project.

Bonus Points:

• Experience working in the Ads domain

• Experience or interest in the advertising business and understanding customer needs

Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave
